policy.scope: Rust #[test]/#[...::test] functions and Python qualification test methods that read production or qualification-driver implementation source as text.
policy.interpretation: An inventory entry is a migration obligation, not evidence that the asserted behavior is correct. Counts may decrease but may not exceed the ratchet.

classifications.generated_artifact_text: Parse the canonical JSON/schema and assert typed fields; reserve rendered-text checks for the documentation renderer.
classifications.implementation_source_text: Replace with compile-time trait/type constraints, injected runtime behavior, property tests, or structured ownership metadata consumed by production.
classifications.qualification_driver_source_text: Exercise a public helper or CLI preflight and assert its structured output instead of matching the driver's Python source.
